entry.content: Open-source tutorials for everyone who want to use Python in their worksSubject to the existing rights of third parties, eigenspaces.github.io and/or host institutions are the copyright owner in this work, and no portion thereof is to be copied, reproduced, or disseminated, including for AI training, without the prior written consent of eigenspaces.github.io.For more information, send email to [email protected]Welcome to Eigen Spaces! This blog is as a knowledge base in understanding application of computational tools for physics or chemistry problems. I hope you find the content useful, and I hope you enjoy reading along and learning with me!And me? Well, I’m Dinda Gusti Ayu . I’m interested in using Machine Learning to learn the rules of Quantum Mechanics and Simulate Crystalline and Amorphous Solid Systems. I earned an MS in chemistry physics at Universitas Sumatera Utara, Indonesia where I studied the fundamental optical properties and defects modelling in direct band-gap semiconductors for materials research.Eigen Spaces is a free, open learning resource for students and researchers who interested in applying Python to solve complex problems, to manage and tranform data, and to produce publication-quality figures. The goal is to take the most efficient approach for describing the link between Python language to a particular concepts in mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.All materials are shared openly on my repositories We can quickly navigate through the sections using the navigation bar on the left side, and the sub navigation bar on the right side. There is also a search box to help us find any content in this page swiftly.Feel free to contact me through email: [email protected]. If you have inquiries and/ or suggestion. Looking forward to hearing from you!Let’s get down with Eigen Spaces!© 2026 Dinda Gusti Ayu The content on this page is licensed under CC-BY 4.0 unless otherwise stated.This page is built with ❤️ and Quarto.

entry.title: Scholar Research Competition - Inari Expo 2023
entry.content:
Participated as a finalist of technology and engineering sciences cluster in Indonesia Research and Innovation Fair organized by the National Research and Innovation Agency of Indonesia (BRIN) and received a special research award recognition from PT Nanotech Indonesia Global Tbk.

The event was held on September 20-23, 2023 at the ICC Building, Science and Technology Soekarno area, Cibinong, Jawa Barat, Indonesia. During the process I presented my research work to four nanotechnology and materials scientists in Indonesia, sharing and communicating it to the public (including graduate and undergraduate students from many universities in Indonesia) through a three-minute research talk (3MT) and scientific poster.

Reference: BRIN-News
entry.summary: A Finalist of Technology and Engineering Sciences Cluster in Indonesia Research and Innovation Fair.
